jobs.title: Teachers Primary
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE ? Collège Champittet, a school of reference in the Lake Geneva region since 1903, offers excellent education to generations of Swiss and foreign students. Its unique spirit revolves around academic performance, multilingualism and values such as respect and trust. The school is part of the Nord Anglia Education family, the world's leading premium schools’ organisation with 89 schools in 32 countries. In this dynamic environment, both local and international, we invite you to join our team. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
• Create a quality teaching environment conducive to learning, fostering learner agency and implementing the principles of positive discipline
• Act as a coach by setting learning objectives that are challenging, inspiring and motivating, within the Collège philosophy
• Adapt teaching to the strengths and needs of each pupil, including those with high ability or with special educational needs
• Communicate effectively and regularly with parents about their children’s achievements and learning
• Give students regular feedback, both orally and through accurate rating PROFILE AND COMPETENCES
• Bachelor ’s degree
• PGCE or equivalent
• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least five years’ experience, ideally in an international environment
• Native English speaker with fluent French
• Valid Swiss work permit and clean criminal records

jobs.title: Driver
jobs.description:
ABOUT US College Alpin Beau Soleil is a unique school community in the Swiss Alps: home to 300 students aged 11-18 from 60 countries around the world and offering an unparalleled educational experience. We believe it’s what you do that counts, and our students take on challenges 7 days each week, in and out of the classroom, that help them develop into young people capable of taking on the world. Curricular programmes in English and French, based around the IB Diploma, provide a foundation for academic success at universities around the world, whilst the experience of living and working with friends from all around the world sets up students as truly global citizens of the future. Everyone is an individual here, but we sum to a very special community. OUR LOCATION Our alpine location in the heart of Villars-sur-Ollon in Switzerland offers an enviable lifestyle with skiing on the doorstep in the winter months and a multitude of outdoor and sporting activities throughout the year. Montreux, Lausanne and Geneva are all within easy reach for cultural adventures and inspiration, but we travel across Europe and around the world too. The Beau Soleil campus is an inspiring place to work, with facilities that are second to none. Students and staff thrive in an environment of which they are proud, and which inspires us to better things every day. YOUR PROFILE Are you passionate about driving and ensuring the safety and comfort of others? At Collège Alpin Beau Soleil, we’re looking for a dedicated Driver to join our team in an 80% position, with a start date to be agreed. We are looking for someone who takes pride in providing exceptional service and enjoys the variety of a dynamic role. As our Driver, you’ll be entrusted with the important responsibility of transporting our students safely and efficiently, whether on daily routes through the beautiful Villars-sur-Ollon region or on journeys across Switzerland and Europe. The Driver ensures that students’ experiences extend smoothly beyond the classroom. But this role is about more than just driving. You’ll also help look after our fleet, ensuring our vehicles are kept in excellent condition and are always ready for the next journey. You’ll manage essential school errands, such as handling important documents from embassies, and provide valuable support during our vibrant Summer Camp. If you take pride in your work, are committed to excellence, and would like to play a key role in supporting our students’ educational experiences, we invite you to join our team. YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Transport students to and from various locations
• Regular inspection and maintenance of all vehicles
• Refuel vehicles at least twice a week
• Run errands to embassies for passport/visa pick-up and drop-off
• Conduct various errands for the school as required
• During winter, ensure that vehicles are cleared of snow and prepared for emergency use
• Serve as a Driver during the Summer Camp
• Occasional travel to foreign countries (Europe) EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Possession of a D, DE, or 95 driving license (essential)
• Holder of the Certificate of Capacity under the Swiss Chauffeur Admission Ordinance (OACP)
• Proficiency in French and/or English YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS Experience
• Several years of experience as a driver, specifically in the transport of passengers Person specification
• Discreet and efficient
• Comfortable with children, and able to command respect
• Service-oriented, with the ability to respond to parents’ requests professionally
• Capable of working independently while being part of a team
• Stress resistance
• Able to drive on snow or any type of terrain HOW TO APPLY Applications should be made via Beau Soleil recruitment website at https://www.beausoleil.ch/careers and should contain a CV, letter of application and the details of two professional referees. The closing date for applications is Friday, 9 October 2026 . Successful short listed candidates will be contacted straight away with initial discussions conducted remotely by telephone or video call. Collège Alpin Beau Soleil is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. A police check is required prior to appointment. • Culturally sensitive and comfortable working in an international environment

jobs.description:
Fondée en 2008, La Côte International School ("LCIS") est une école de langue anglaise, qui accueille près de 420 élèves âgés de 3 à 18 ans. Nichée entre les vignobles et les vergers d'Aubonne, en Suisse, l'école internationale de La Côte se trouve à proximité de Genève et de Lausanne. Nous offrons à nos étudiants des expériences d’apprentissage internationales inégalées, inspirées par nos collaborations avec Juilliard, le MIT et l’UNICEF. Notre programme d’études sur mesure offre à nos élèves la possibilité de suivre un parcours en anglais, en français ou bilingue menant au programme du diplôme du baccalauréat international (IBDP), de renommée internationale. C’est dans cet environnement dynamique que nous vous invitons à rejoindre notre équipe : Assistant-e Socio-éducatif-ve 100% – dès décembre 2026 Responsibilités:
• Établir des relations positives et bienveillantes avec les élèves, les collègues et les parents.
• Soutenir l’apprentissage, le développement et le bien-être des élèves en répondant à leurs besoins individuels. Accompagner les enfants dans les routines quotidiennes, notamment les repas, l’hygiène, l’habillage, les temps de repos et les transitions, tout en favorisant leur autonomie et en veillant à leur offrir un environnement sûr, bienveillant et épanouissant.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’enseignant(e) de la classe afin de contribuer à la planification et à la mise en œuvre d’activités d’apprentissage stimulantes, notamment dans le cadre d’un accompagnement individuel ou en petits groupes.
• Observer et suivre les progrès des élèves et transmettre ses observations à l’enseignant(e) de la classe, en contribuant, lorsque nécessaire, aux plans d’apprentissage individualisés et aux mesures de soutien.
• Contribuer à créer un environnement d’apprentissage sûr, positif et stimulant et participer à la surveillance et à l’encadrement des élèves tout au long de la journée scolaire ainsi que lors des activités organisées par l’école.
• Faire preuve de professionnalisme, de discrétion et d’une attitude positive, collaborer efficacement avec ses collègues et participer aux formations et activités scolaires pertinentes. Qualifications et compétences :
• CFC d’Assistant/e socio-éducatif/ve (ASE) ou qualification équivalente reconnue en Suisse par le SEFRI – indispensable.
• Bonne connaissance du développement de l’enfant et expérience professionnelle auprès d’enfants en bas âge (0 à 5 ans).
• Une expérience auprès d’enfants d’âge primaire (5 à 11 ans) constituerait un atout.
• Personne proactive et adaptable, faisant preuve d’initiative, de professionnalisme et d’attention aux besoins des autres.
• Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais constituerait un atout important, ainsi qu’une volonté de travailler dans un environnement anglophone.
• Personne bienveillante, patiente et enthousiaste, capable d’établir des relations positives avec les enfants, les parents et les collègues.
• Personne fiable et bien organisée, capable de travailler aussi bien de manière autonome qu’en équipe. Interessé-e à rejoindre note équipe? Merci de bien vouloir nous faire parvenir votre dossier complet en format électronique uniquement par le biais de notre site internet.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE ? Collège Champittet, a school of reference in the Lake Geneva region since 1903, offers excellent education to generations of Swiss and foreign students. Its unique spirit revolves around academic performance, multilingualism and values such as respect and trust. The school is part of the Nord Anglia Education family, the world's leading premium schools’ organisation with 89 schools in 32 countries. In this dynamic environment, both local and international, we invite you to join our Academic Team. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
• Design and implement an ICT curriculum that aligns with educational standards and promotes criti-cal thinking and problem-solving
• Deliver engaging and interactive lessons that cater to diverse learning styles and adapt teaching to the strengths and needs of each pupil, including those with high ability or with special educational needs
• Create a quality teaching environment conducive to learning, fostering learner agency and imple-menting the principles of positive discipline
• Act as a coach by setting learning objectives that are challenging, inspiring and motivating, within the Collège philosophy, and provide students with regular feedback, both orally and through accu-rate rating
• Communicate effectively and regularly with parents about their children’s achievements and learning PROFILE AND COMPETENCIES
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT
• PGCE or equivalent
• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least five years’ experience, ideally in an in-ternational environment
• Native English speaker with fluent French
• Valid Swiss work permit and clean criminal recor If you are passionate about education and interested in joining our team, please apply directly online through our website.

Il suo spirito unico ruota intorno alle prestazioni accademiche, al multilinguismo e ai valori come il rispetto e la fiducia. La scuola fa parte della famiglia Nord Anglia Education, l’organizzazione leader mondiale delle scuole premium con 89 scuole in 32 paesi. In questo ambiente dinamico, sia locale che internazionale, vi invitiamo a partecipare al nostro team accademico. CONTI DI LAVORO
• Progettare e implementare un curriculum ICT che si allinea agli standard educativi e promuove il pensiero critico e la risoluzione dei problemi
• Fornire lezioni coinvolgenti e interattive che si rivolgono a stili di apprendimento diversi e adattare l'insegnamento ai punti di forza e alle esigenze di ogni allievo, compresi quelli con alta capacità o con esigenze educative speciali
• Creare un ambiente di insegnamento di qualità che favorisca l'apprendimento, la promozione dell'agenzia di apprendimento e l'attuazione dei principi della disciplina positiva
• Agire come allenatore impostando obiettivi di apprendimento che sono impegnativi, ispiranti e motivanti, all'interno della filosofia Collège, e fornire agli studenti un feedback regolare, sia per via orale e attraverso la valutazione accurata
• Comunicare efficacemente e regolarmente con i genitori circa i risultati dei loro figli e imparare PROFILE E COMPETENZIONI
• Corso di laurea o master in IT
• PGCE o equivalente
• Provato record di eccellenza nell’insegnamento con almeno cinque anni di esperienza, idealmente in un ambiente in-ternazionale
• Altoparlante inglese nativo con francese fluente
• Valido permesso di lavoro svizzero e riparo criminale pulito Se siete appassionati di istruzione e interessati ad unirsi al nostro team, si prega di applicare direttamente online attraverso il nostro sito web.

jobs.title: Nurse on-call
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. ​ We welcome children from 2 to 18 years old to become part of a truly international community with more than 120 different nationalities. Our vision is to shape generations that harness differences and empower our students to change the world for the better. We nurture individual strengths through our outstanding educators and the sheer breadth of opportunities that we offer as part of our curriculum and activities. Collège du Léman is part of the Nord Anglia Education family of more than 80 premium schools, educating students in over 30 countries. MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE To ensure the safe and efficient delivery of clinical care within the school The School Nurse – On Call plays a key role in ensuring the safe, responsive and high-quality delivery of nursing care within the school environment. Working collaboratively as part of a team of three school nurses, the role supports students’ physical wellbeing while contributing to a calm, caring and professional medical service. The nurse communicates effectively and professionally with students, parents, staff and school leadership, ensuring that all medical information is handled with accuracy, discretion and confidentiality. Medical centre records and administrative tasks are maintained in line with school and regulatory requirements. This is an on-call position, with working hours scheduled according to the operational needs of the department. Additional availability may be required during the summer period, in line with school activities, camps and student presence. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Delivering safe, high-quality and efficient nursing care to students while on duty, in line with professional standards and school policies.
• Assessing health needs independently and providing appropriate care, treatment and follow-up, including responding effectively to medical emergencies.
• Maintaining accurate, clear and up-to-date medical records, ensuring confidentiality and compliance with regulatory and school requirements.
• Upholding safeguarding, child protection principles and professional boundaries at all times.
• Acting as a key link between the Medical Centre and the wider school community, promoting effective communication with students, parents, boarding staff and academic teams.
• Communicating professionally and compassionately with parents regarding students’ health, wellbeing and any required follow-up.
• Supporting health education, prevention and wellbeing initiatives within the school as required.
• Demonstrating flexibility and adaptability to meet the evolving operational needs of the department, including on-call duties and seasonal peak periods. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
• Demonstrating evidence of ongoing professional development and a genuine interest in primary nursing and adolescent healthcare.
• Applying strong clinical judgement and remaining calm, resilient and effective when working under pressure or in emergency situations.
• Communicating clearly, professionally and empathetically with students, parents, colleagues and school leadership.
• Building positive and trusting relationships while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
• Working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team and contributing to a supportive and efficient medical service.
• Adapting flexibly to changing priorities, on-call requirements and seasonal variations in workload.
• Showing cultural awareness and sensitivity within a diverse international school community.
• Managing time effectively and maintaining high standards of organisation and attention to detail. Qualificiation A nursing qualification recognised by Swiss law is required . Previous experience in emergency and paediatric nursing is highly desirable.The role requires excellent oral and written communication skills in both English and French. Prior knowledge of primary nursing and healthcare education for adolescents will be considered a strong asset. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
CHI SIAMO Collège du Léman è una delle scuole internazionali più prestigiose della Svizzera, situata ai margini del Lago di Ginevra in vista delle Alpi svizzere. Accogliamo i bambini dai 2 ai 18 anni per entrare a far parte di una comunità internazionale con più di 120 nazionalità diverse. La nostra visione è quella di modellare le generazioni che sfruttano le differenze e permettono ai nostri studenti di cambiare il mondo per il meglio. Nutriamo i punti di forza individuali attraverso i nostri eccellenti educatori e la pura ampiezza delle opportunità che offriamo come parte del nostro curriculum e delle nostre attività. Collège du Léman fa parte della famiglia Nord Anglia Education di oltre 80 scuole premium, educando studenti in oltre 30 paesi. MAIN PURPOSE DEL RUOLO Per garantire la consegna sicura ed efficiente dell'assistenza clinica all'interno della scuola La Scuola Infermiera – On Call svolge un ruolo chiave nel garantire la consegna sicura, reattiva e di alta qualità dell'assistenza sanitaria all'interno dell'ambiente scolastico. Lavorando in collaborazione come parte di un team di tre infermiere scolastiche, il ruolo supporta il benessere fisico degli studenti, contribuendo a un servizio medico calmo, attento e professionale. L'infermiera comunica efficacemente e professionalmente con studenti, genitori, personale e leadership scolastica, assicurando che tutte le informazioni mediche siano gestite con accuratezza, discrezione e riservatezza. I registri del centro medico e i compiti amministrativi sono mantenuti in linea con i requisiti scolastici e normativi. Si tratta di una posizione on-call, con orari di lavoro programmati in base alle esigenze operative del dipartimento. Ulteriori disponibilità possono essere richieste durante il periodo estivo, in linea con le attività scolastiche, i campi e la presenza degli studenti. RISPOSTE DI LAVORO
• Fornire assistenza infermieristica sicura, di alta qualità ed efficiente agli studenti mentre sono in servizio, in linea con gli standard professionali e le politiche scolastiche.
• Valutare le esigenze di salute in modo indipendente e fornire cure adeguate, trattamento e follow-up, compreso rispondere efficacemente alle emergenze mediche.
• Mantenere registri medici accurati, chiari e aggiornati, garantendo la riservatezza e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e scolastici.
• Sostenere la tutela, i principi di protezione dei bambini e i confini professionali in ogni momento.
• Agire come un collegamento chiave tra il Centro Medico e la più ampia comunità scolastica, promuovendo una comunicazione efficace con studenti, genitori, personale di imbarco e team accademici.
• Comunicare professionalmente e compassionevolmente con i genitori per quanto riguarda la salute degli studenti, il benessere e qualsiasi follow-up richiesto.
• Sostenere le iniziative di educazione sanitaria, prevenzione e benessere all'interno della scuola.
• Dimostrando flessibilità e adattabilità per soddisfare le esigenze operative in evoluzione del reparto, compresi i dazi on-call e i periodi di picco stagionale. SKILLE E COMPETENZE
• Dimostrando le prove dello sviluppo professionale in corso e un autentico interesse per la cura primaria e la salute degli adolescenti.
• Applicando forte giudizio clinico e rimanendo calma, resiliente ed efficace quando si lavora sotto pressione o in situazioni di emergenza.
• Comunicare chiaramente, professionalmente ed empaticamente con studenti, genitori, colleghi e leadership scolastica.
• Costruire relazioni positive e fiduciose mantenendo i confini professionali appropriati.
• Lavorare collaborativamente all'interno di un team multidisciplinare e contribuire a un servizio medico di supporto ed efficiente.
• Adattare in modo flessibile al cambiamento delle priorità, alle esigenze di vendita e alle variazioni stagionali del carico di lavoro.
• Mostrare la consapevolezza culturale e la sensibilità all'interno di una variegata comunità scolastica internazionale.
• Gestione efficace del tempo e mantenimento di elevati standard di organizzazione e attenzione ai dettagli. Qualificiazione Una qualifica di allattamento riconosciuta dal diritto svizzero è richiesta. Esperienza precedente in emergenza e allattamento pediatrico è altamente auspicabile. Il ruolo richiede eccellenti capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta sia in inglese che in francese. La conoscenza prioritaria dell'istruzione primaria e sanitaria per gli adolescenti sarà considerata un bene forte. INFORMAZIONI ESSENTI È importante che il titolare del post sia sempre a conoscenza delle linee guida per la protezione dei bambini e osservi una distanza professionale dagli studenti, pur sviluppando relazioni di lavoro e cura efficaci. Voi comprendete e abbracciate l'importanza della diversità e dell'inclusione e mettetevi contro la discriminazione in qualsiasi forma. Le indagini di fondo e i controlli di riferimento per gli ultimi dieci anni saranno condotti durante il processo di selezione.

In Zusammenarbeit als Teil eines Teams von drei Schulkrankenschwestern unterstützt die Rolle das körperliche Wohlbefinden der Schüler und trägt gleichzeitig zu einem ruhigen, fürsorglichen und professionellen medizinischen Dienst bei. • Aufrechterhaltung korrekter, klarer und aktueller Krankenakten, Gewährleistung der Vertraulichkeit und Einhaltung regulatorischer und schulischer Anforderungen.
• Schutz, Kinderschutzgrundsätze und berufliche Grenzen jederzeit.
• Als ein wichtiges Bindeglied zwischen dem Medizinischen Zentrum und der breiteren Schulgemeinschaft, Förderung einer effektiven Kommunikation mit Schülern, Eltern, Internatspersonal und akademischen Teams.

• Unterstützung von Gesundheitserziehungs-, Präventions- und Wohlbefindensinitiativen innerhalb der Schule nach Bedarf.
• Nachweis von Flexibilität und Anpassungsfähigkeit, um den sich ändernden betrieblichen Anforderungen der Abteilung gerecht zu werden, einschließlich Bereitschaftsdiensten und saisonalen Spitzenzeiten. FÄHIGKEITEN UND ZUSTÄNDIGE
• Nachweise für die laufende berufliche Entwicklung und ein echtes Interesse an der primären Pflege- und Jugendversorgung.

• Zusammenarbeit in einem multidisziplinären Team und Beitrag zu einem unterstützenden und effizienten medizinischen Service.
• Flexible Anpassung an sich ändernde Prioritäten, Bereitschaftsdienste und saisonale Schwankungen der Arbeitsbelastung.
• Kulturelles Bewusstsein und Sensibilität innerhalb einer vielfältigen internationalen Schulgemeinschaft zeigen.

Travaillant en collaboration dans le cadre d'une équipe de trois infirmières de l'école, ce rôle soutient le bien-être physique des élèves tout en contribuant à un service médical calme, attentionné et professionnel. L'infirmière communique efficacement et professionnellement avec les élèves, les parents, le personnel et la direction de l'école, en veillant à ce que tous les renseignements médicaux soient traités avec exactitude, discrétion et confidentialité. Les dossiers des centres médicaux et les tâches administratives sont tenus conformément aux exigences de l'école et de la réglementation. Il s'agit d'un poste de garde, avec des heures de travail prévues en fonction des besoins opérationnels du ministère. Des disponibilités supplémentaires peuvent être requises pendant la période estivale, conformément aux activités scolaires, aux camps et à la présence des élèves. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

• Maintenir des dossiers médicaux exacts, clairs et à jour, en assurant la confidentialité et la conformité aux exigences réglementaires et scolaires.
• Maintien des principes de protection de l'enfance et des limites professionnelles en tout temps.
• En tant que lien essentiel entre le Centre médical et l'ensemble de la communauté scolaire, promouvoir une communication efficace avec les élèves, les parents, le personnel des internats et les équipes universitaires.
• Communication professionnelle et compatissante avec les parents concernant la santé, le bien-être et tout suivi nécessaire.
• Soutenir les initiatives en matière d'éducation, de prévention et de bien-être en milieu scolaire, selon les besoins.
• Faire preuve de souplesse et d'adaptabilité pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels changeants du Ministère, y compris les fonctions de garde et les périodes de pointe saisonnières. COMPÉTENCES
• Démontrer des preuves de développement professionnel continu et un véritable intérêt pour les soins infirmiers primaires et les soins aux adolescents.
• Appliquer un jugement clinique fort et rester calme, résistant et efficace lorsque vous travaillez sous pression ou en situation d'urgence.
• Communiquer clairement, professionnellement et empathiquement avec les élèves, les parents, les collègues et le leadership scolaire.
• Établir des relations positives et confiantes tout en maintenant des limites professionnelles appropriées.
• Travailler en collaboration au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire et contribuer à un service médical de soutien et efficace.
• S'adapter avec souplesse aux changements de priorités, aux besoins en matière d'appel et aux variations saisonnières de la charge de travail.
• Faire preuve de sensibilisation et de sensibilité culturelles au sein d'une communauté scolaire internationale diversifiée.
• Gérer efficacement le temps et maintenir des normes élevées d'organisation et d'attention aux détails. La connaissance préalable des soins infirmiers primaires et de l'éducation sanitaire des adolescents sera considérée comme un atout important. Vous comprenez et reconnaissez l'importance de la diversité, de l'inclusion et de la lutte contre toute forme de discrimination. Des enquêtes de fond et des vérifications des références seront effectuées au cours du processus de sélection au cours des dix dernières années.

jobs.description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE Boarding House Tutors are key members of our boarding community, bringing energy, enthusiasm, and a flexible, student-centred approach to daily boarding life. Working closely with the House Parents, they provide pastoral care, support students' well-being and personal development, contribute to the smooth running of the house, and help create a safe, inclusive, and engaging environment. This role is ideal for people looking to gain valuable experience in education, youth development, or pastoral care. As trusted role models, Boarding House Tutors encourage students to develop independence, resilience, confidence, and positive life skills while contributing to a warm and supportive boarding community. KEY RESPONSABILITIES Pastoral Care: Act as a trusted point of contact for students, offering emotional support and practical guidance. Collaborate with House Parents and the Health Centre to ensure students’ emotional, social, and physical well-being. Community Leadership: Foster a positive and inclusive house environment, promoting teamwork, respect, and responsibility. Encourage student engagement in house activities, celebrations, and competitions. Activity Involvement: Participate actively in a range of student activities and excursions, setting a positive example. Support evening, weekend, and holiday activity schedules, promoting student participation. Operational Support : Assist with the daily operations of the house, including meal supervision, laundry oversight, and student wake-up and bedtime routines. Support House Parents in ensuring the house environment is clean, organized, and safe. Administrative Duties: Ensure accurate and timely record-keeping for attendance, student check-ins, and other administrative tasks. Contribute to student progress reports, sharing observations with House Parents and the senior boarding team. Safety and Security: Monitor student whereabouts and ensure they adhere to curfews and daily schedules. Follow protocols for handling missing students, fire drills, and medical emergencies. Role Modeling: Demonstrate empathy, patience, and integrity, embodying the core values of the boarding community. Support students from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds as they integrate into boarding life. SKILLS AND COMPETENCES
• Previous experience working with children or young people is highly desirable.
• A positive, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to complete administrative tasks effectively.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is an asset.
• Enthusiasm for boarding life, with a willingness to participate in activities and excursions.
• Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues, students, and parents.
• A driving license is preferred. Driving duties are an integral part of the job.
• Resilience and adaptability to work in a fast-paced, student-centered environment. You are an energetic, enthusiastic, team player, but also resistant to pressure and well organised. You have a good sense of humour and believe in positive and respectful relationships. You have excellent interpersonal skills, especially with students. Your level of English is excellent. Experience in working with children and young people is a prerequisite. You will be exhausted at the end of the day, but the rewards will be extraordinary! WHY JOIN US? Be part of a vibrant international community in a stunning location. Enjoy access to a wide range of professional development opportunities and cultural activities. Benefit from on-campus accommodation and amenities. Make a lasting impact on students’ lives while advancing your career in an environment that values positivity, initiative, and care. TERMS AND CONDITIONS Boarding House Tutor will be required to work throughout the term, with one day off per week and one weekend off once every two weeks. Accommodation in a Boarding House will be provided from the start of the year until the end of the academic year. The monthly salary is CHF2,000.- Meals are also provided during term time. Private health insurance is compulsory in Switzerland, and as part of the package, CDL will offer Health Insurance to eligible Boarding Graduate Assistants, and we will cover up to CHF 250 of their transportation costs for the first travel. Boarding House Tutors will then have priority on the application for our amazing summer camps. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. We welcome children from 2 to 18 years old to become part of a truly international community with more than 120 different nationalities. Our vision is to shape generations that harness differences and empower our students to change the world for the better. We nurture individual strengths through our outstanding educators and the sheer breadth of opportunities that we offer as part of our curriculum and activities. Collège du Léman is part of the Nord Anglia Education family of more than 80 premium schools all over the world.

MAIN PURPOSE DEL REOLE Boarding House Tutors sono membri chiave della nostra comunità di imbarco, portando energia, entusiasmo, e un approccio flessibile, studente-centro alla vita di imbarco quotidiana. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i Genitori della Casa, essi forniscono assistenza pastorale, sostengono il benessere degli studenti e lo sviluppo personale, contribuiscono al buon funzionamento della casa, e contribuiscono a creare un ambiente sicuro, inclusivo e coinvolgente. Questo ruolo è ideale per le persone che cercano di acquisire una preziosa esperienza nell'educazione, nello sviluppo giovanile o nella cura pastorale. Come modelli di ruolo di fiducia, Boarding House Tutors incoraggia gli studenti a sviluppare l'indipendenza, la resilienza, la fiducia e le competenze di vita positive, contribuendo a una comunità di imbarco calda e solidale. KEY RESPONSABILITIES Pastoral Care: agire come punto di fiducia di contatto per gli studenti, offrendo supporto emotivo e guida pratica. Collabora con i genitori della casa e il centro sanitario per garantire agli studenti il benessere emotivo, sociale e fisico. Leadership comunitaria: promuovere un ambiente di casa positivo e inclusivo, promuovere il lavoro di squadra, il rispetto e la responsabilità. Incoraggia il coinvolgimento degli studenti nelle attività di casa, nelle celebrazioni e nelle competizioni. Attività Coinvolgimento: Partecipa attivamente in una gamma di attività e escursioni studentesche, definendo un esempio positivo. Sostegno serale, fine settimana e programmi di attività di vacanza, promozione della partecipazione degli studenti. Supporto Operativo: Assistere con le operazioni quotidiane della casa, compresa la supervisione del pasto, la supervisione del bucato, e le routine di sveglia e di riposo degli studenti. Support House Genitori nel garantire l'ambiente domestico è pulito, organizzato e sicuro. Amministrazioni: Assicurare la registrazione accurata e tempestiva per la presenza, i check-in degli studenti e altri compiti amministrativi. Contribuisci ai rapporti sui progressi degli studenti, condividendo le osservazioni con i genitori della casa e il team di imbarco senior. Sicurezza e sicurezza: Monitorare la posizione degli studenti e assicurarsi di aderire ai coprifuoco e agli orari giornalieri. Seguire i protocolli per gestire gli studenti mancanti, le esercitazioni antincendio e le emergenze mediche. Role Modeling: Dimostrare empatia, pazienza e integrità, incarnando i valori fondamentali della comunità di imbarco. Sostenere gli studenti da diversi background culturali e linguistici come si integrano nella vita di imbarco. SKILLS E COMPETENZE
• Esperienza precedente lavorare con bambini o giovani è altamente auspicabile.
• Una mentalità positiva, proattiva e orientata alla soluzione.
• Forte capacità organizzativa con la capacità di completare i compiti amministrativi in modo efficace.
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione in inglese. La conoscenza del francese è una risorsa.
• Entusiasmo per la vita di imbarco, con la volontà di partecipare a attività ed escursioni.
• Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con colleghi, studenti e genitori.
• Una patente di guida è preferita. I compiti di guida sono parte integrante del lavoro.
• Resilienza e adattabilità al lavoro in un ambiente frenetico e orientato agli studenti. Sei un giocatore di squadra energico, entusiasta, ma anche resistente alla pressione e ben organizzato. Hai un buon senso dell'umorismo e credi in relazioni positive e rispettose. Hai eccellenti capacità interpersonali, soprattutto con gli studenti. Il tuo livello di inglese è eccellente. L'esperienza nel lavorare con i bambini e i giovani è un prerequisito. Sarete esauriti alla fine della giornata, ma le ricompense saranno straordinarie! Perche'? Fai parte di una vivace comunità internazionale in una splendida posizione. Godetevi l'accesso a una vasta gamma di opportunità di sviluppo professionale e attività culturali. Approfitta della sistemazione e dei servizi on-campus. Fare un impatto duraturo sulla vita degli studenti mentre avanza la tua carriera in un ambiente che valori la positività, l'iniziativa e la cura. TERMS E CONDIZIONI Il Tutor della Camera d'imbarco sarà tenuto a lavorare per tutto il termine, con un giorno di riposo a settimana e un fine settimana di riposo una volta ogni due settimane. L'alloggio in una Boarding House sarà fornito dall'inizio dell'anno fino alla fine dell'anno accademico. Lo stipendio mensile è di CHF2,000.- I pasti sono forniti anche durante il periodo di tempo. L'assicurazione sanitaria privata è obbligatoria in Svizzera, e nell'ambito del pacchetto, CDL offrirà l'assicurazione sanitaria agli assistenti di imbarco idonei, e copriremo fino a CHF 250 dei loro costi di trasporto per il primo viaggio. Boarding House Tutors avrà quindi la priorità sulla richiesta per i nostri incredibili campi estivi. INFORMAZIONI ESSENTI È importante che il titolare del post sia sempre a conoscenza delle linee guida per la protezione dei bambini e osservi una distanza professionale dagli studenti, pur sviluppando relazioni di lavoro e cura efficaci. Voi comprendete e abbracciate l'importanza della diversità e dell'inclusione e mettetevi contro la discriminazione in qualsiasi forma. Le indagini di fondo e i controlli di riferimento per gli ultimi dieci anni saranno condotti durante il processo di selezione. CHI SIAMO Collège du Léman è una delle scuole internazionali più prestigiose della Svizzera, situata ai margini del Lago di Ginevra in vista delle Alpi svizzere. Accogliamo i bambini dai 2 ai 18 anni per entrare a far parte di una comunità internazionale con più di 120 nazionalità diverse. La nostra visione è quella di modellare le generazioni che sfruttano le differenze e permettono ai nostri studenti di cambiare il mondo per il meglio. Nutriamo i punti di forza individuali attraverso i nostri eccellenti educatori e la pura ampiezza delle opportunità che offriamo come parte del nostro curriculum e delle nostre attività. Collège du Léman fa parte della famiglia Nord Anglia Education di oltre 80 scuole premium in tutto il mondo.

Boarding house tutor müssen während der gesamten laufzeit arbeiten, mit einem freien tag pro woche und einem freien wochenende einmal alle zwei wochen. Boarding house tutoren haben dann priorität bei der bewerbung für unsere erstaunlichen sommercamps. WESENTLICHE INFORMATIONEN Es ist wichtig, dass der Posteninhaber immer die Kinderschutzrichtlinien kennt und eine professionelle Distanz zu den Schülern einhält, während er dennoch effektive Arbeits- und Pflegebeziehungen entwickelt. Sie verstehen und umarmen die Bedeutung von Vielfalt und Inklusion und stehen gegen Diskriminierung in jeglicher Form. Hintergrunduntersuchungen und Referenzkontrollen der letzten zehn Jahre werden während des Auswahlprozesses durchgeführt. WER WIR SIND Collège du Léman ist eine der renommiertesten internationalen Schulen der Schweiz, am Rande des Genfer Sees mit Blick auf die Schweizer Alpen. Wir begrüßen Kinder von 2 bis 18 Jahren, um Teil einer wirklich internationalen Gemeinschaft mit mehr als 120 verschiedenen Nationalitäten zu werden. Unsere Vision ist es, Generationen zu formen, die Unterschiede nutzen und unsere Schüler dazu befähigen, die Welt zum Besseren zu verändern. Wir fördern individuelle Stärken durch unsere hervorragenden Pädagogen und die schiere Breite der Möglichkeiten, die wir als Teil unseres Lehrplans und unserer Aktivitäten anbieten. En tant que modèles de confiance, les Tuteurs d'arraisonnement encouragent les étudiants à acquérir l'indépendance, la résilience, la confiance et des compétences de vie positives tout en contribuant à une communauté d'arraisonnement chaleureuse et solidaire. Collaborer avec les parents de la maison et le Centre de santé pour assurer le bien-être émotionnel, social et physique des étudiants. Leadership communautaire : Favoriser un milieu de travail positif et inclusif, promouvoir le travail d'équipe, le respect et la responsabilité. Encourager l'engagement des étudiants dans les activités, les célébrations et les concours de la maison. Participation à l'activité : Participer activement à toute une gamme d'activités et d'excursions étudiantes, en donnant un exemple positif. Soutenir la soirée, le week-end et les horaires des activités de vacances, promouvoir la participation des étudiants. Soutien opérationnel : Aider aux opérations quotidiennes de la maison, y compris la supervision des repas, la surveillance de la lessive, le réveil des étudiants et les routines de coucher. Soutenir les parents en veillant à ce que l'environnement familial soit propre, organisé et sécuritaire. Fonctions administratives : Veiller à ce que la tenue des dossiers soit exacte et opportune pour la présence, l'enregistrement des étudiants et d'autres tâches administratives. Contribuer aux rapports d'avancement des élèves, en partageant leurs observations avec les parents de la maison et l'équipe d'internat principale. Sécurité et sûreté : Surveiller les endroits où les élèves se trouvent et s'assurer qu'ils respectent les couvre-feux et les horaires quotidiens. Suivez les protocoles pour gérer les élèves disparus, les exercices d'incendie et les urgences médicales. Modélisation des rôles : Démontrer l'empathie, la patience et l'intégrité, en incorporant les valeurs fondamentales de la communauté de l'embarquement. Soutenir les étudiants de diverses origines culturelles et linguistiques lorsqu'ils s'intègrent à la vie d'embarquement. COMPÉTENCES ET COMPÉTENCES
• L'expérience antérieure de travail avec des enfants ou des jeunes est hautement souhaitable.
• Un état d'esprit positif, proactif et axé sur la solution.
• De solides compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité d'accomplir efficacement les tâches administratives.
• Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de communication en anglais. La connaissance du français est un atout.
• Enthousiasme pour la vie d'embarquement, avec une volonté de participer aux activités et excursions.
• Capacité de travailler en collaboration avec des collègues, des étudiants et des parents.
• Un permis de conduire est préféré. Les fonctions de conduite font partie intégrante du travail.
• Résilience et adaptabilité au travail dans un environnement rapide et centré sur les étudiants. Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe énergique, enthousiaste, mais aussi résistant à la pression et bien organisé. Vous avez un bon sens de l'humour et croyez en des relations positives et respectueuses. Vous avez d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, surtout avec les étudiants. Votre niveau d'anglais est excellent. L'expérience du travail avec les enfants et les jeunes est une condition préalable. Vous serez épuisés en fin de journée, mais les récompenses seront extraordinaires ! Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Faites partie d'une communauté internationale dynamique dans un endroit magnifique. Profitez d'un large éventail de possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel et d'activités culturelles. Bénéficiez d'hébergements et d'équipements sur le campus. Faites un impact durable sur la vie des étudiants en faisant progresser votre carrière dans un environnement qui valorise la positivité, l'initiative et les soins. MANDAT ET CONDITIONS Le tuteur de la maison d'embarquement sera tenu de travailler pendant toute la durée du mandat, avec un jour de congé par semaine et un week-end de congé une fois toutes les deux semaines. L'hébergement dans une maison d'embarquement sera assuré du début de l'année jusqu'à la fin de l'année scolaire. Le salaire mensuel est de CHF 2.000.- Les repas sont également fournis pendant la durée de la période. L'assurance-maladie privée est obligatoire en Suisse, et dans le cadre de l'ensemble, CDL offrira l'assurance-maladie aux assistants diplômés admissibles à l'embarquement, et nous couvrirons jusqu'à CHF 250 de leurs frais de transport pour le premier voyage. Embarquement House Tutors aura alors la priorité sur l'application pour nos camps d'été étonnants. CE QU'IL FAUT SAVOIR Il est important que le titulaire de poste soit toujours conscient des lignes directrices en matière de protection de l'enfance et observe une distance professionnelle par rapport aux étudiants tout en développant des relations de travail et de soins efficaces. Des enquêtes de fond et des vérifications des références seront effectuées au cours du processus de sélection au cours des dix dernières années. QUI NOUS sommes Collège du Léman est l'une des écoles internationales les plus prestigieuses de Suisse, situé au bord du lac Léman en vue des Alpes suisses. Nous accueillons des enfants de 2 à 18 ans pour faire partie d'une communauté internationale authentique avec plus de 120 nationalités différentes. Notre vision est de façonner des générations qui exploitent les différences et permettent à nos élèves de changer le monde pour le mieux. Nous cultivons nos forces individuelles par l'entremise de nos éducateurs exceptionnels et de l'ampleur des possibilités que nous offrons dans le cadre de notre programme et de nos activités. Le Collège du Léman fait partie de la famille Nord Anglia Education de plus de 80 écoles haut de gamme dans le monde entier.

jobs.description:
La Cote International School (LCIS) is a school that aims to make a difference every day. We are passionate about education and seeing young people grow and develop, and we want the same for our colleagues. If you join us, you will become part of a team that is a genuine family, committed to each other and to the students we serve. LCIS is a co-educational, English language based, day school that welcomes nearly 450 students between 3 and 18 years old. Nestled in Switzerland amongst vineyards and fruit orchards, between Lac Léman and the Jura mountains, we are also within very easy commuting distance from Geneva and Lausanne. It is a truly great environment to live and work. We offer our students unparalleled international learning experiences, including those inspired by our collaborations with Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. Our customized curriculum offers our students the opportunity to follow an English, French or bilingual pathway leading to the internationally renowned International Baccalaureate Diploma Program (IBDP), as well as discovering new skills, abilities and interest. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to apply to join our team: Learning Support Assistants (Student Shadows) Speculative applications – primary – secondary – hourly role Responsibilities:
• Provide support to students with additional learning needs within the classroom.
• Motivate students to achieve beyond their potential.
• Encourage students to communicate effectively.
• Help children understand instructions.
• Assist children who need extra support to complete various tasks.
• Supervise group activities.
• Communicate with teachers, the SEN department and parents about student progress. Qualifications and Skills:
• 1-3 years of experience in a similar role.
• Fluency in English; working knowledge of French is an asset.
• Relevant degree.
• Excellent communication skills, discretion, and a team player attitude.
• Empathetic, calm, positive, motivational, creative, and flexible.
• Availability throughout the day and week during school hours.
• Local residency.
• Clear criminal record. If you are passionate about education and interested in joining our team, please apply directly online through our website. Please note that this is an ongoing advertisement, as we may have unexpected Learning Support needs arise throughout the year, though there may not be an immediate vacancy at this time. If you share our passion for education and would like to join our team, please apply directly online through our website.

jobs.description:
Fondée en 2008, La Côte International School ("LCIS") est une école de langue anglaise, qui accueille près de 420 élèves âgés de 2 à 18 ans. Nichée entre les vignobles et les vergers d'Aubonne, en Suisse, l'école internationale de La Côte se trouve à proximité de Genève et de Lausanne. • Permis de conduire professionnel Suisse D ou D1, sans limitations, pour conduire les minibus de plus de 3,5 tonnes
• OACP à jour et carte (verte) de qualification de conducteur
• Très bonne connaissance des routes dans la région de La Côte, un atout

jobs.title: House Parent Part time Male
jobs.description:
Location: Geneva, Switzerland Start date: Aug -26 Report to: Heads of House MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE House Parents are at the heart of our boarding community, combining warmth, flexibility, and initiative to foster a nurturing and inspiring environment. They are mentors, role models, and leaders who ensure students feel secure and supported while embracing opportunities for personal growth. This dynamic role requires a proactive and positive approach, as House Parents lead by example—whether through participating in activities, encouraging students to discover their passions, or helping manage day-to-day operations of the boarding house. By setting the standard in enthusiasm and resilience, House Parents inspire students to thrive in all aspects of their lives. K EY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Pastoral Care: Act “in loco parentis” to ensure students’ emotional, social, and physical well-being. Collaborate with the Counselling team and Health Centre to address individual needs​​. Staying overnight in the boarding House when on duty is an expectation.
• Academic Tracking: Monitor students’ academic progress, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals. Liaise with teachers to address concerns and celebrate achievements​​.
• Community Leadership: Encourage teamwork, respect, and responsibility among boarders, instilling core values and promoting a positive house culture​​.
• Activity Involvement: Actively engage in student activities to lead by example, inspiring students to pursue their interests and develop a balanced, passionate approach to life​​.
• Operational Support: Oversee daily logistics such as dining supervision, weekend activities, and occasional transportation, including driving students when required​​.
• Communication: Maintain regular and open communication with parents, providing updates on their child’s well-being, academic progress, and personal development​​.
• Crisis Management: Respond to maintenance issues, medical emergencies, or missing students using established protocols​​​.
• Administrative Duties: Maintain accurate records and ensure all administrative tasks are handled efficiently for the smooth running of the House​​.
• Role Modeling: Exhibit empathy, patience, and cultural sensitivity to help students from diverse backgrounds integrate and thrive​​. S KILLS AND COMPETENCES
• Previous experience working with children or young people.
• A proactive and positive mindset, demonstrating resilience and adaptability in a dynamic environment.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage administrative tasks and maintain accurate records.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is a significant asset, as it facilitates communication in a bilingual environment.
• A genuine enthusiasm for boarding life, including leading and participating in student activities.
• A collaborative spirit and ability to build meaningful relationships within a diverse team and student body.
• A valid driving license, as occasional transportation of students is expected.
• A proactive attitude toward personal and professional development. You are an energetic, enthusiastic, team player, but also resistant to pressure and well organised. You have a good sense of humour and believe in positive and respectful relationships. You have excellent interpersonal skills, especially with students. Your level of English is excellent. experience in working with children and young people is a prerequisite. You will be exhausted at the end of the day, but the rewards will be extraordinary! WHY JOIN US? Be part of a vibrant international community in a stunning location. Enjoy access to a wide range of professional development opportunities and cultural activities. Benefit from on-campus accommodation and amenities. Make a lasting impact on students’ lives while advancing your career in an environment that values positivity, initiative, and care. TERM AND CONDITION As a Part-time House Parent you work one day per week and one weekend every other week. Accommodation and meals in a Boarding House will be provided when on duty. You need to have your own accommodation for your days off.Please note that applications are open to European citizens or holders of a Swiss work permit. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. jobs.description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Bilingual Learning Support Teacher provides flexible learning support services across the school according to operational needs. The role focuses on identifying students' learning needs and supporting them in achieving their full potential within the classroom environment whenever possible. The Learning Support Teacher collaborates closely with teachers, school leaders, parents, and external professionals to ensure that support strategies are aligned with individual student needs. In partnership with classroom teachers, the Learning Support Teacher develops and delivers targeted interventions that can, where appropriate, be integrated into regular classroom practice. This position offers flexible assignments based on the school's requirements and may involve supporting students across different year groups and learning support programmes. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The Learning Support Teacher is responsible, in collaboration with the teacher, for:
• Planning, organising and implementing specific interventions to develop literacy, numeracy and language skills for students who have identified specific learning differences (to include HP)
• Providing in class’s support or small groups pull-outs as appropriate
• Providing 1:1 support for those students with significant learning differences which have been identified by an external evaluation. This involves:
• Completing student observations and evaluations.
• Collaborating with teachers to provide classroom management suggestions and plans regarding identified students
• Mentoring assistants and support staff as appropriate
• Communication with parents in collaboration with the classroom teacher, Principals and/or Deputies
• Collaborating with School Counsellor and external specialists
• Providing regular feedback to principal/deputies. Additional Responsibilities
• Presenting a positive role model by employing appropriate and respectful interactions with students and staff
• Maintaining own records for identified students.
• Leading workshops with teachers and other staff for professional development
• Remaining current in the field of Learning Differences by attending in-service programs, mandated staff meetings trainings and self-selected workshops and conferences.
• Attending reviews or other related meetings
• Assisting with playground supervision and special activities as requested. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES (The abilities that the individual needs in order to perform this role effectively)
• Good organisational skills
• Establish and maintain positive relationships with students and parents.
• Ability to take initiative and accept responsibility
• Awareness of confidential processes and an ability to respect confidentiality
• Ability to work as part of a team
• Dynamic, committed yet flexible
• Willingness to embrace the latest developments in education for those with Learning Differences (including HP) and a commitment to ongoing Professional Development
• Ability to use IPADS/computers to stimulate interest in learning
• Ability to work with administrative and regular Office software (Word, Excel, Outlook...)
• Assessing students formally and informally including standardised assessments, screeners and use these to assess data to inform support for those students in need.
• Providing regular feedback on progress and achievements to individual student's teachers and parents.
• The learning support teacher will serve as a case manager for students receiving learning support services, including writing IEPs and keeping the students learning support master list up to date
• Fluent in English (level C1 minimum reading/writing speaking).French desirable at B1 level. Desirable skills:
• Familiar with the MTSS inclusive framework
• Experience in administrating standardiaed assessments and diagnostic screeners.
• A minimum of 2 years of special educational/learning support teaching in a diverse setting QUALIFICATION To be considered for this position, you must possess a BA (QTS)/BSc (QTS) or equivalent, or a BA/BSc with a PGCE or MA in Special Education. Alternatively, a B.Ed or CAPSAIS/CAPA-SH qualification is also acceptable. Preferred qualifications include experience in Speech and Language Therapy. EXPERIENCE In terms of experience, you should demonstrate an ability to evaluate a student’s needs and develop appropriate interventions, both in small group settings and within larger classes. Previous experience working with Preschool/Primary aged children with specific learning needs is highly valued, as well as an understanding of confidential processes and a commitment to respecting confidentiality. Additionally, experience with different cultures and familiarity with programmes for high-potential (HP) students are considered advantageous.
